title: Jerusalem's Impending Destruction

questions.question: "Flee for safety, O people of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in..., and raise a signal on Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms out of the north..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:1 (ESV): "Blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a signal on Beth-haccherem,"

questions.question: "The lovely and delicately bred I will destroy, the daughter of..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:2 (ESV): "The lovely and delicately bred I will destroy, the daughter of Zion."

questions.question: "Prepare war against her; up, and let us attack at noon! Woe to us, for the day declines, for the shadows of evening..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:4 (ESV): "Woe to us, for the day declines, for the shadows of evening lengthen!"

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord of hosts: 'Cut down her trees; cast up a... against Jerusalem. This is the city that must be punished; there is nothing but oppression within her.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:6 (ESV): "Cut down her trees; cast up a siege mound against Jerusalem."

questions.question: "As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps fresh her..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:7 (ESV): "As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps fresh her evil;"

questions.question: "To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? Behold, their... are uncircumcised, they cannot listen;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:10 (ESV): "Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, they cannot listen;"

questions.question: "Therefore I am full of the wrath of the Lord; I am weary of holding it in. Pour it out upon the... in the street, and upon the gatherings of young men, also;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:11 (ESV): "Pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the gatherings of young men, also;"

questions.question: "For from the least to the greatest of them, everyone is greedy for unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, everyone deals..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:13 (ESV): "and from prophet to priest, everyone deals falsely."

questions.question: "They have healed the wound of my people lightly, saying, '..., ...,' when there is no..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:14 (ESV): "saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace."

questions.question: "Were they ashamed when they committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed; they did not know how to..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:15 (ESV): "they did not know how to blush."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord: "Stand by the roads, and look, and ask for the... paths, where the good way is; and walk in it, and find... for your souls."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:16 (ESV): "ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is; and walk in it, and find rest for your souls."

questions.question: But the people said regarding the ancient paths and the good way, "We will not..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:16 (ESV): "But they said, 'We will not walk in it.'"

questions.question: "I set... over you, saying, 'Pay attention to the sound of the trumpet!' But they said, 'We will not pay attention.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:17 (ESV): "I set watchmen over you, saying, 'Pay attention to the sound of the trumpet!'"

questions.question: "Hear, O earth; behold, I am bringing disaster upon this people, the fruit of their devices, because they have not paid attention to my..., and as for my law, they have rejected it."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:19 (ESV): "because they have not paid attention to my words;"

questions.question: The Lord asks, "What use to me is frankincense that comes from Sheba, or sweet... from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 6:20 (ESV): "or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable,"

key_verse_text: Thus says the Lord: "Stand by the roads, and look, and ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is; and walk in it, and find rest for your souls. But they said, 'We will not walk in it.'"
